messages.content: Make one narrow chapter-boundary decision. Return valid JSON only.

A chapter is a large H3 refresh unit.

STORY:
A mechanic starts diagnosing an engine, tests several components, replaces a failed sensor, then continues testing the same engine.

LEFT:
Initial diagnosis and component tests.

RIGHT:
Replace the failed sensor and continue testing the same engine.

Choose one decision from this allowed set: MERGE, KEEP.
Return a JSON object with "decision" and "reason".
